AKE Safety Equipment manufactures STOP-FYRE® —  The World's BEST Fire Extinguisher®, a U.S.-made, clean-agent fire suppression solution engineered for high-stakes, operational environments where people, equipment, and missions must be protected. 

For more than 35 years, AKE has focused on one goal: building a better fire extinguisher for the people who may truly need one. As the nation’s only firefighter-owned, operated, and endorsed fire extinguisher manufacturer, AKE brings real fireground experience into every handheld unit, automatic system, and custom fire protection solution we build. 

STOP-FYRE® was designed to solve problems that traditional dry-chemical extinguishers and PFAS-containing firefighting foam technologies can leave behind. Dry chemical extinguishers can create a corrosive mess that damages electronics, optics, weapon systems, hydraulics, and engines. That can mean longer repairs, more downtime, and exposing crews to additional hazard after the fire is out. 

STOP-FYRE® uses a non-corrosive clean agent and does not rely on PFAS-containing firefighting foam technology. It helps protect what matters most: troop lives, mission-critical equipment, and the ability to keep moving when every second matters. In high-stress fire situations, survivability depends on fast, simple, reliable fire protection that can be used quickly. 

AKE's competitive advantages are built around real-world use. STOP-FYRE® is compact and adaptable for form, fit, and function across different vehicles, compartments, and equipment needs be it legacy or next-generation platforms. Our units are durable, lightweight, multi-shot, and easy to operate under pressure. Instead of one-and-done discharge, STOP-FYRE® gives users more control when conditions are unpredictable. 

For program managers, engineers, and purchasing teams, AKE offers effective fire protection that supports warfighter survivability, platform readiness, and long-term value. Backed by our Lifetime No-Hassle Guarantee™, STOP-FYRE® is more than another fire extinguisher. It is clean, dependable protection for service members, vehicles, and mission-critical assets that cannot afford to fail.

RESPONSES.RESPONSE_TEXT: For over 35 years, AKE has delivered fire protection where mission failure is not an option. As the nation's only firefighter-owned, operated, and endorsed extinguisher manufacturer, we engineer survivability into every platform — tailoring reliable, intuitive, long-life STOP-FYRE® systems for warfighters, vehicles, and high-value assets the Joint Force depends on.

DIRECTORY.DESCRIPTION:
The BDSV represents the interests of the entire German Security and Defence Industry at both the national and international level. Its work aims to preserve the competitiveness and viability of the German Security and Defence Industry.

The BDSV consists of more than 550 members, which are globally operating companies and highly innovative SMEs. Both are privately held and profit-oriented.

The German Fundamental Law as well as the Rules of Procedure of the Federal Government recognize the necessity of federations. Therefore, the consultation of concerned federations is institutionalized in the German political system. The BDSV is thus a point of contact for the parliament, the Federal Government as well as for ministries. Moreover, the BDSV maintains relations to other associations, the media and relevant NGOs. By organizing round tables and dialogues, the BDSV has established itself as the main point of contact in the domain of security and defence industry.

As a consequence of the Europeanization of many policies, including the increasing importance of industrial policies on the European level, structures have become more and more complex during the last decade. Expertise, especially regarding legal issues, is essential. The BDSV is therefore also active on the European level and offers ist expertise to relevant actors.

On the international level, the BDSV is a member of both the European umbrella association ASD and NIAG. Additionally, the BDSV is the relevant point of contact for foreign delegations. The close cooperation between the BDSV and BDSV-Exhibitions ensures the presence of German companies on international trade fairs.

Integrating advanced technology and innovative design, the BlueRoom Mixed Reality Simulator sets a new standard in military medical training, ensuring our forces are always ready and equipped to respond effectively.

Drones have the power to revolutionize how we work and live, but the limitations of lithium-ion batteries have held them back, affecting payload capacity, flight distance, and endurance. In the defense market, systems integrators have created unmanned aerial vehicles that resemble their manned counterparts and are powered with aviation fuel. Both defense and commercial operators have made leverage of lithium ion batteries to fuel smaller drones for logistics and surveillance missions. Historically missing from the market has been a middle ground: drones that can operate with agility and cost-effectiveness, but conduct longer, more strategic missions.

In 2019, HevenDrones was created with a clear vision: to unlock the immense potential of the drone ecosystem. We set out to create an actionable drone ecosystem designed for the future of conflict and commercial industries. Today, we're doing just that by exploring hydrogen as a game-changing fuel source for drones. From complete heavy lift-drones to flight controllers and operating systems, Heven develops the hardware and software that is enabling the next generation of autonomous and actionable drone platforms. 

Core to HevenDrones’ technology is its use of hydrogen — a fuel with unmatched energy density and environmental benefits. Not only does hydrogen enhance drone capabilities, but it also minimizes the carbon footprint of this technology and harnesses a secure and readily available energy supply. Hydrogen, with its incredible potential to maximize endurance and performance, offers solutions to many limitations the drone industry faces. 

We are developing the core technologies and platforms that will fundamentally transform what drones can do, creating faster, more efficient, and sustainable mobility solutions. Our multidisciplinary and highly experienced R&D team continuously works on developing drones that can lift heavier payloads for longer flight times.

SAR Imaging: Produces fine-resolution imagery by synthesizing very large apertures through the movement of the airborne platform. 



Coherent/Magnitude Change Detection (CCD/MCD): Compares multiple SAR images of a scene and automatically detects and highlights changes.



Ground Moving Target Indication (GMTI): Detects and tracks moving ground targets over a wide area. 



Maritime Moving Target Indication (MMTI): Uses a wide-area search to detect and track moving targets in maritime environments. 



Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar (ISAR): Generate two- dimensional, high resolution images in maritime environments.



SAR Motion Video (SMV): Produces a Full-Motion Video (FMV)-like live stream of the radar imagery.

DIRECTORY.DESCRIPTION:
Lowental Hybrid develops advanced hybrid propulsion systems for tactical UAVs and loitering munitions, enabling unmanned platforms to fly farther, stay on mission longer, and operate with greater flexibility in demanding field environments.

The company’s Native Parallel Hybrid™ architecture combines electric propulsion and an internal combustion engine on a shared drivetrain. This allows platforms to use quiet electric power when low signature is required, fuel-based power for extended endurance and range, and hybrid operation when missions demand additional performance or onboard energy capacity.

As tactical unmanned systems take on larger roles in reconnaissance, targeting, strike support, and dispersed operations, propulsion is becoming a critical mission enabler. Emerging U.S. Army and broader defense requirements, including Long Range Reconnaissance (LRR), highlight the need for systems that can reduce logistics burden, support field units, extend operational reach, and help close the loop between sensing and effects.

Lowental Hybrid’s propulsion systems are designed to address these needs by combining the simplicity and low-signature benefits of electric flight with the endurance, fuel compatibility, and power generation advantages of combustion-based systems. The company’s solutions support mission profiles where endurance, survivability, payload capacity, and operational flexibility must work together rather than compete across contested, distributed, and logistics-constrained operating environments.

Lowental Hybrid’s product portfolio includes scalable propulsion systems for Group 2-3 UAV platforms and loitering munitions, as well as aerial generators for drone applications. Designed for military fuel logistics, the company’s products utilize heavy-fuel engines to meet rigorous deployment standards.

Led by a team with deep experience in defense, aviation, UAV propulsion, and operational systems, Lowental Hybrid works with OEMs, integrators, and defense partners seeking propulsion architectures built for the next generation of tactical unmanned operations.

At AUSA 2026, Lowental Hybrid will present mission-ready hybrid propulsion solutions aligned with the evolving operational demands of modern land forces worldwide today.

DIRECTORY.DESCRIPTION:
Tantec develops and manufactures advanced surface treatment solutions based on plasma and corona technology. With more than 50 years of experience, Tantec helps companies improve adhesion, bonding, printing, coating, and painting on a wide range of materials, including plastics, metals, composites, rubber, glass, and ceramics.

Many modern materials have low surface energy, which can make it difficult for adhesives, inks, coatings, or paints to bond properly. Tantec’s surface treatment technologies modify the surface at a microscopic level, creating better conditions for strong and reliable adhesion without the use of primers, solvents, or mechanical abrasion.

The technology is used across industries where process stability, product quality and repeatability are critical. This includes defense, aerospace, automotive, electronics, medical devices, packaging, and advanced manufacturing. Tantec solutions can be integrated into manual, semi-automatic and fully automated production environments, depending on the customer’s production setup and technical requirements.

Tantec offers a broad range of technologies, including atmospheric plasma, corona treatment, and vacuum plasma systems. Each solution is adapted to the specific material, component geometry, production flow and process requirements. From small precision components to larger industrial parts, Tantec helps customers find the right treatment method for their application.
